BiblicalUsage: Ruined is the state of a sanctuary left desolate, and the prophets use this word for the land and for the heart. Daniel prays for the sanctuary that is desolate, Jeremiah says the whole land is made desolate because no man lays it to heart, and Lamentations cries that God has made the singer desolate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe desolation is what is left when God withdraws, and the only cure for it is the prayer Daniel prayed, that God would cause His face to shine.
